description: Implementation of ProductAttributeService handling CRUD and retrieval operations for product attributes in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for handling product attribute-related business logic, extending generic entity service and implementing ProductAttributeService.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a ProductAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieve a list of ProductAttributes by option ID within a specific store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieve ProductAttributes by a list of attribute IDs for a specific store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieve ProductAttributes by option value ID within a specific store.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Retrieve all product attributes associated with a specific product, store, and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new or update an existing ProductAttribute.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a ProductAttribute, ensuring it is attached before deletion.
